The '''2023 Retro League Event 2''' was the second event of the [[2023 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (12 March – 22 April 2023), played in [[Premiere - Endor]] format.<ref name="t82164" /> [[Brad Kippel]] won.

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 12 March – 22 April 2023
* '''Players:''' 57 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Kippel]]
